title: straightening functor
why_consulted: DAG vol1 ch5 §5.1：Segal 对象/群胚对象经直化-反直化对应到预栈上的范畴对象，用于构造卷积幺半结构
definition_zh: 直化（straightening）与反直化（unstraightening）是 Lurie 在《Higher Topos Theory》§3.2 中建立的 Quillen 等价：它把单纯集上的（局部）常纤维化与 sSet-富化预层互相转换，因而是 $(\infty,1)$-Grothendieck 构造的模型实现。给定内范畴或群胚对象 $\mathcal{R}^{\bullet}$，反直化把其上的 Segal 对象对应为 $\mathcal{R}$ 上的函子，直化取逆；DAG 借此把预栈的群胚对象等同于「范畴对象」。
key_points: 直化把 sSet-富化预层（函子 $\mathbf{C}^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$）送到单纯集上的（余）纤维化，反直化取其逆。
二者构成 Quillen 等价，因此在 $(\infty,1)$-范畴层面是等价，而不只是同伦等价。
DAG ch5 §5 用它把群胚对象 $\mathcal{R}^{\bullet}$ 的 Segal 条件翻译为 $\mathcal{R}$ 上的范畴对象，从而得到作用在 $\mathcal{X}$ 上的单子 $\mathbf{M}_{\mathcal{R}}$。
同一套机器也用于 Čech 神经：proper 概形态射的 Čech 神经给出对应的 pull-push 单子。
idea_original: When (∞,1)-categories are modeled as quasi-categories, the (∞,1)-Grothendieck construction takes the form of a Quillen equivalence between a model structure on sSet-enriched presheaves and a slice model structure of simplicial sets which has been introduced under the name straightening and unstraightening in Lurie 2009, Sec. 3.2: Concretely, in the notation recalled at relation between quasi-categories and simplicial categories: For a simplicial set SS, simplicially enriched category CC, and sSet-enriched functor ℭ[S]→C\mathfrak{C}[S] \to C, there is a pair of adjoint functors (St ϕ⊣Un ϕ):sSet/S→St[C op,sSet] (St_\phi\dashv Un_\phi) \;\colon\; sSet/S \xrightarrow{\;\; St \;\;} [C^{op}, sSet] which (under an assumption on the parameter ϕ\phi) can be shown to be a Quillen equivalence between the slice category of sSet equipped with the model structure for right fibrations (also called contravariant model structure in HTT) the category of simplicial presheaves equipped with global projective model structure. There is also a Quillen equivalence (St ϕ⊣Un ϕ):sSet +/S⟶St[C op,sSet +] (St_\phi \dashv Un_\phi) \;\colon\; sSet^+/S \stackrel{St}{\;\; \longrightarrow \;\;} [C^{op}, sSet^+] bet
